name: doxcards
description: DoxCards - Multiplayer Red Flags Türkçe Kart Oyunu (Cloudflare Pages & Workers Uyumlu)

scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build:client: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "red,cyan" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:win: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "red,cyan" "npm.cmd --prefix server run dev" "npm.cmd --prefix client run dev"

author: Burak
